facts.fact: Simi Mobile, a subsidiary of Engo Holding operating from the Kampala Industrial and Business Park at Namanve, launched Uganda-made smartphones on 30 November 2024 and is exporting them, per minister Evelyn Anite.

note: Electronics assembly is only an objective of the programme; no plant in production is stated.
